# Security Policy

## Scope

This policy covers the SmartPay website, any contracts published under the project, and tooling in this repository.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do **not** open a public issue for a security problem.

Use the repository's private vulnerability reporting (the "Report a vulnerability" button under the Security tab). A dedicated contact address will be listed here once the project has stated one.

Include:

- A description of the issue and its impact
- Steps or a proof of concept to reproduce
- The affected file, contract or URL
- Your preferred name for credit, if any

## What to expect

| Step | Target |
| --- | --- |
| Acknowledgement | within 3 business days |
| Initial assessment | within 7 days |
| Fix or mitigation plan | communicated as soon as it is known |

Reports are handled in confidence. Credit is given after a fix ships unless you ask to stay anonymous.

## Good-faith research

We will not pursue action against researchers who test only their own accounts and funds, avoid degrading the service for others, do not exfiltrate data beyond what is needed to prove the issue, and give us reasonable time to respond before disclosure.

## Out of scope

- Findings that require a compromised device or browser
- Social engineering of maintainers
- Missing best-practice headers with no demonstrated impact
- Volumetric denial of service

## Things we will never ask for

The team will never ask for a seed phrase, private key or wallet password, in any channel. Treat any message that does as an impersonation and report it.

## Contract audits

Payment contracts will be audited before they hold user funds, and full reports will be linked from the documentation. No audit has been completed yet.
